description:
Resume helper: read the box's saved state and tell you EXACTLY where a deploy stands
    and what to do next - the phase it reached, the next tool(s) to call, and the inputs those
    need. Use this whenever you (or another agent) lost track mid-deploy or picked up a
    half-finished box: it turns the static `workflow` playbook into a concrete 'you are here,
    do this next'. Read-only.
name: next_step
